title: Chapter 173 Gold Equipment Blueprint
content:
Chapter 173 Gold Equipment Blueprint

Wadang Mountain, Qingmu Village.

After Wang Shuo arranged the affairs of the territory, he brought Gong Zheng, Jiang Yingyu, and more than 20 soldiers here.

The tall village gate is at least 8 meters high, and it is built on a 2-meter-high stone platform.

Both sides are blocked by boulders. If you want to attack the mountain village, you can only force the village gate.

There are several watchtowers on both sides, connected by wood, making a passage for people to pass through.

A large number of archers can stand on them to carry out long-range attacks on the enemies in front of the village gate.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but take a breath.

Fortunately, he didn't rush to attack, otherwise no matter how many people came, they might not be able to capture this mountain village.

Seeing Wang Shuo coming, the soldiers guarding the village quickly opened the village gate and welcomed Wang Shuo in.

The mountain village is full of rough buildings.

The most majestic building in the middle is the meeting hall. When you walk in, you can see a huge tiger skin chair, which looks majestic and domineering.

However, the animal bones and meat on the ground were still emitting bursts of meaty aroma, making the hall look a bit dirty.

And there were also scattered pieces of wine bowls, which made the ground look even more messy.

Wang Shuo walked over carefully, sat on the tiger skin chair, and looked into the distance. The view was surprisingly wide. If the weather was fine, he could even see the foot of the mountain.

Wang Shuo casually wandered around in the backyard again. There were dense jungles all around, exotic flowers and plants everywhere, bursts of fragrance filled the air, and ravines and gullies in the distance. The view was excellent, and Wang Shuo felt relaxed and happy.

It’s just that the style of the building is not exquisite enough, otherwise, this place must be a beautiful mountain villa!

After just a simple appreciation, Wang Shuo said to Jiang Yingyu: "Where is the treasure of the mountain village?"

"Lord, please follow me."

Jiang Yingyu led Wang Shuo and others to a hidden cellar.

"Lord, be careful, there are traps here!" Wang Shuo was shocked. He was amazed that these bandits still had such a sense of defense, and was also surprised that Jiang Yingyu, a small mountain thief, actually knew all this.

"Lord, don't be surprised. I just asked a bandit leader who had followed the boss into the mountain, and I found out about this."

Jiang Yingyu explained when he saw Wang Shuo's surprised expression.

Wang Shuo was shocked and quickly checked his loyalty. He found that it was still 100%, and then he felt relieved.

It seems that this little thief still has some brains.

It was a little dim in the cellar. After Jiang Yingyu lit the oil lamp, Wang Shuo found his golden treasure chest at a glance, which was placed on a shelf.

It was filled with a large amount of gold and silver treasures, as well as various weapons and equipment.

However, these were not what Wang Shuo valued most. On the shelf, several scrolls caught Wang Shuo's attention.

["Golden Leaf Fish Scale Armor" production drawings: 10 gold ingots + 10 fine iron ingots + Hidden Moon Line + Defense Rune Enchantment 1 time, requiring a senior blacksmith. Military standard armor, can be mass-produced. 】

The other one is the "rhinoceros leather armor" production drawing, which is also gold equipment.

Wang Shuo was ecstatic when he saw these two gold equipment drawings.

If they can be mass-produced, the defense of his troops will be improved by several levels.

After seeing that it requires a senior blacksmith, Wang Shuo finally understood why it was put on the shelf.

Wang Shuo frowned. It seems that Matar is only an intermediate blacksmith. Only by going back to ask, can we know if there is a way to make it.

He looked at another palm-sized animal skin, and after opening it, it turned out to be a treasure map fragment.

In this way, Wang Shuo has collected 3 treasure map fragments. As long as he goes back and takes out the other two, he can know the secret of this treasure map.
